summary: End of the example facts: processor list, ansible_processor_cores/count/vcpus, product name and version, ansible_python (executable, version), SELinux status, ansible_service_mgr, SSH host keys, swap, ansible_system, user facts, virtualization role and type, and gather_subset; then how to reference a value such as the first disk's model.
questions: How do I get the number of CPUs from Ansible facts?
